checked_en: Swept on Monday morning, November 16, before the opening bell, covering the seven days to today. Four entries go on the record and three of them are new since Saturday. Working backwards. This morning the Wall Street Journal reported that more than two dozen American artificial-intelligence companies — Nvidia, Microsoft, Amazon, OpenAI and Anthropic among those named in coverage — are to be designated “national champions”, a label meant to help them sell abroad against Chinese rivals. Nothing has been published, the report is unconfirmed, and the coverage is explicit that it is not clear what the label would actually entitle a company to. Also reported this morning: Senator Maria Cantwell wrote to the Commerce Secretary on Sunday urging him to enforce export controls and stop advanced AI chips reaching companies barred from receiving them, and called the 25% fee the President attached to Nvidia's China sales a perverse financial incentive to approve exports. On Sunday the Treasury Secretary, Scott Bessent, said on Fox News that Nvidia's board should hire its next chief executive from outside the company, asked whether it had been pressing seemingly illicit sales to flatter its revenue, and said he wants answers from the board within 10 days — two days before Nvidia reports its quarter. And on Saturday evening, with the market shut, the President posted that shares lost “3 Trillion Dollars in Value” immediately after the election, adding that the market has since gone up; the entry works through both halves of that. Only the last of the four is his own words. The other three are an officer of his administration, a senator, and a report of a decision he has not announced — and each entry says which it is in its opening lines, because on a record like this that difference is the information. He has posted nothing about a company since Saturday evening. The Truth Social archive runs to a post from 6:05 this morning Eastern — 3:05 in the morning Pacific time — and nothing between the Saturday post and that one names a company, an industry or an investment; Sunday evening's posts were about Iran, the troops and a Justice Department letter to Senator Warren. Three things were checked and deliberately left out. The campaign to reinstate Jensen Huang, now past 170,000 signatures with Elon Musk among those signing — that is shareholders, executives and the public, not him. Reporting that he is unlikely to raise the Nvidia affair with Xi Jinping when they meet on Thursday, which is officials speaking and not him. And the Federal Reserve chairman's speech at 9 this morning Pacific time, which belongs on the calendar on the main part of this page, not here. entries.text_en: Reported by the Wall Street Journal on Monday, November 16, citing people familiar with the matter, and read here through outlets carrying the report because the Journal is behind a paywall. The reporting is unconfirmed: the outlet read for this entry says plainly that it could not verify it. It is set down as reporting rather than inside quote marks, because none of it is a public statement of his. What is reported. More than two dozen American artificial-intelligence companies are to be designated “national champions”, with Nvidia, Microsoft, Amazon, OpenAI and Anthropic among those named in the coverage. The purpose described is commercial rather than domestic: to offer foreign governments and companies packages of American chips, AI models and related products so that they buy the American stack instead of a Chinese one. It builds on the American AI Exports Program created by an executive order in July 2025. The Commerce Secretary, Howard Lutnick, is expected to unveil the list, which coverage says is expected within about a week, and he travels with the President to the APEC summit in Shenzhen on November 18 and 19. Why it is on this record. This section logs what the President does about companies as well as what he says about them, and a government label attached to a named list of firms, aimed at winning them business overseas, is an action about companies. What this is not. No money, no contract, no tariff, no export licence, and no published rule. Coverage is explicit that it is not clear what the designation would actually entitle a company to — the phrase is the kind governments use for firms they intend to favour, and the mechanism has not been described. A note this record should make plainly. Nvidia is named on this list by one part of the administration while another part is publicly questioning the same company: on Sunday the Treasury Secretary said Nvidia needs a chief executive from outside the company and asked whether it had been pressing seemingly illicit sales to flatter its revenue. Both are in this record, dated, and this page does not try to reconcile them.

entries.headline: The chip-export decision he made in December came under direct pressure in a letter sent on Sunday and reported on Monday, days before he meets Xi Jinping. The senior Democrat on the Senate Commerce Committee, Maria Cantwell, wrote to the Commerce Secretary urging him to enforce export controls and stop the flow of advanced AI chips to companies barred from receiving them — and called the 25% fee the President attached to Nvidia's China sales “a perverse financial incentive to approve exports of sensitive American technology”

entries.text_en: Reported on Monday, November 16, and set down as reporting rather than inside quote marks, because none of it is a statement of his. What happened. Senator Maria Cantwell, the ranking Democrat on the Senate Commerce Committee, sent a letter on Sunday to the Commerce Secretary, Howard Lutnick, calling on him to enforce export controls and stop the flow of advanced AI chips to companies barred from receiving the technology. Her words, and they are hers. “The Department of Commerce has resisted efforts to restrict companies flagged as national security threats, weakened safeguards, and left open pathways for the PRC to train advanced AI models using sensitive American technology.” And: “These failures to carry out the law help give away America's technology advantage in AI.” Why this belongs on a record of what the President does. The arrangement she is asking to be undone is his. In December he said the United States would allow Nvidia to ship its second-most powerful chip, the H200, to approved customers in China, with 25% of those sales paid to the American government; in January the rule moved H200-class chips from refusal to case-by-case review, with a 25% tariff on a narrow range of advanced computing chips. Cantwell's letter calls that fee a perverse financial incentive to approve exports. She also says the department suspended an investigation into Megaspeed, the Singapore firm American officials suspect of routing Nvidia chips into China, and points to the firm run by the Commerce Secretary's sons having held $1.2 billion of Nvidia stock at the time of his nomination. The surrounding pressure. Members of both parties have pressed the department since a November 9 New York Times report that it may have slow-walked the Megaspeed investigation. The Treasury Secretary has said the Treasury, the Pentagon, the State Department and the Trade Representative's office favoured putting Megaspeed on a trade blacklist for months while the Commerce Department did not. What this is not. A senator's letter is not policy and changes nothing by itself. The H200 arrangement stands, no company has been listed or sanctioned, no export licence has been withdrawn, and a spokesperson for the Commerce Secretary declined to comment on the letter. The President has said nothing publicly about it.
entries.text_ko: 11월 16일 월요일에 보도됐고, 그의 발언이 아니므로 따옴표 안이 아니라 보도로 적습니다. 무슨 일이 있었나. 상원 상무위원회의 야당 간사인 마리아 캔트웰 상원의원이 일요일에 상무장관 하워드 러트닉에게 서한을 보내, 수출 통제를 집행하고 기술을 받을 수 없게 지정된 회사들로 고성능 AI 반도체가 흘러가는 것을 막으라고 요구했습니다. 여기 인용한 말은 대통령이 아니라 캔트웰 의원의 말입니다. “상무부는 국가안보 위협으로 지목된 회사를 제한하려는 노력에 저항했고, 안전장치를 약화시켰으며, 중국이 민감한 미국 기술로 고성능 AI 모델을 학습시킬 길을 열어 두었다.” 그리고 “법을 집행하지 못한 이 실패들은 AI에서 미국의 기술 우위를 내주는 데 도움이 된다.” 이것이 대통령이 한 일의 기록에 오르는 이유. 그가 되돌리라는 요구를 받는 그 조치가 대통령의 것입니다. 지난해 12월 그는 미국이 엔비디아의 두 번째로 강력한 반도체 H200을 중국의 승인된 고객에게 보낼 수 있게 하겠다고 말했고, 그 판매액의 25%는 미국 정부에 내게 했습니다. 1월에는 규정이 H200급 반도체를 거부에서 사안별 심사로 옮겼고, 일부 고성능 컴퓨팅 반도체에는 25% 관세가 붙었습니다. 캔트웰의 서한은 그 수수료를 수출 승인을 부추기는 비뚤어진 금전적 유인이라고 부릅니다. 또 상무부가 Megaspeed에 대한 조사를 중단했다고 적습니다. Megaspeed는 엔비디아 반도체를 중국으로 돌려보낸다고 미국 당국이 의심하는 싱가포르 회사입니다. 그리고 상무장관의 아들들이 운영하는 회사가 그의 지명 당시 엔비디아 주식 12억 달러를 보유했던 점을 지적합니다. 둘레의 압력. 상무부가 Megaspeed 조사를 늦췄을 수 있다는 11월 9일 뉴욕타임스 보도 이후, 양당 의원들이 이 부처를 압박해 왔습니다. 재무장관은 재무부와 국방부, 국무부, 무역대표부가 Megaspeed를 무역 제한 명단에 올리는 데 몇 달 동안 찬성했지만 상무부는 그러지 않았다고 말했습니다. 이것이 아닌 것. 상원의원의 서한은 정책이 아니고 그 자체로 바뀌는 것은 없습니다. H200 조치는 그대로이고, 명단에 오르거나 제재를 받은 회사도 없으며, 취소된 수출 허가도 없고, 상무장관 대변인은 이 서한에 대한 언급을 거절했습니다. 대통령은 이에 대해 공개적으로 아무 말도 하지 않았습니다.

entries.headline: On Sunday television the Treasury Secretary, Scott Bessent, said Nvidia's board should look outside the company for its next chief executive, called for a dramatic shakeup, asked whether the company had been “pressing these seemingly illicit sales to goose their revenues and their earnings”, and said he wants answers “in the next 10 days from the board and from the outside counsel”. He also said that if Nvidia were a bank, “a lot of the executives would be removed”. This is the Treasury Secretary speaking, two days before Nvidia reports its quarter
entries.company_en: Nvidia — and the speaker is the Treasury Secretary, not the President. Nvidia is held outright on this page, is the largest single piece of both SPX and QQQ, and is tripled inside SOXL, which is why an administration officer questioning its reported sales reaches four of the five. What is in dispute is whether the company followed American export rules, and whether sales through other firms flattered its revenue. No finding exists either way
entries.company_ko: 엔비디아 — 그리고 말한 사람은 대통령이 아니라 재무장관입니다. 엔비디아는 이 페이지에서 직접 보유하고 있고, SPX와 QQQ 양쪽에서 가장 큰 한 조각이며, SOXL 안에서는 세 배로 담겨 있습니다. 그래서 행정부 인사가 이 회사의 발표 매출을 의심하는 일이 다섯 중 넷에 닿습니다. 다투어지는 것은 이 회사가 미국의 수출 규정을 지켰는지, 그리고 다른 회사들을 거친 판매가 매출을 좋게 보이게 했는지입니다. 어느 쪽으로도 밝혀진 결론은 없습니다
entries.text_en: Said by the Treasury Secretary, Scott Bessent, on Fox News's Sunday Morning Futures on Sunday, November 15. The sentences below are in quote marks because they are his, exactly as reported; they are not the President's, and the White House has said nothing about them. What he said, quoted. On the succession: “This makes me think that, as the board conducts a search for a new leader, that they need to go outside the company.” On the company: “I want to keep coming back to what was the culture at Nvidia, and were they pressing these seemingly illicit sales to goose their revenues and their earnings?” On a deadline: “I think we need answers in the next 10 days from the board and from the outside counsel.” Reporting of the same weekend remarks also quotes him saying, “if this were a bank and they hadn't complied like this, the OCC would be in there right now and a lot of the executives would be removed”, and describes him calling for a dramatic shakeup and for a new chief executive hired from outside. He had spoken about the company on CNBC on Friday as well. The subject. Whether Nvidia complied with American rules on chip exports to China, and whether it knowingly sold through other companies to get round the restrictions. He again put the failure to place Megaspeed, the Singapore firm suspected of routing Nvidia chips into China, on a trade blacklist down to the Commerce Department, saying the Treasury and other agencies had favoured it for months while Commerce “has the pen”. Why it is on this record. This section logs what the administration says about companies, not only what the President says, and it already carries his own remarks about who should run Nvidia and his decisions about what Nvidia may ship. A cabinet officer publicly doubting a company's reported revenue, two days before that company reports, belongs next to them. What this is not. No finding, no charge, no rule, no penalty. Nothing has been established against Nvidia or against Jensen Huang, who resigned on November 12; Nvidia did not immediately comment. A question asked on television is a question, not a conclusion, and this page will record what is established rather than what is alleged.
entries.text_ko: 재무장관 스콧 베선트가 11월 15일 일요일, 폭스뉴스 선데이 모닝 퓨처스에서 한 말입니다. 아래 따옴표 안의 문장들은 보도된 그대로 그의 말입니다. 대통령의 말이 아니고, 백악관은 이에 대해 아무 말도 하지 않았습니다. 그가 한 말, 그대로. 후임 문제에 대해: “이것은 이사회가 새 지도자를 찾는 과정에서 회사 밖으로 나가야 한다는 생각이 들게 한다.” 회사에 대해: “나는 엔비디아의 문화가 어땠는지로 계속 돌아가고 싶다. 그들이 매출과 이익을 부풀리려고 불법으로 보이는 이 판매들을 밀어붙이고 있었는가?” 기한에 대해: “나는 앞으로 열흘 안에 이사회와 외부 법률대리인으로부터 답을 받아야 한다고 생각한다.” 같은 주말 발언을 다룬 보도들은 그가 “이것이 은행이고 이렇게 규정을 지키지 않았다면 통화감독청이 지금 들어가 있을 것이고 임원 상당수가 물러났을 것이다”라고 말한 것도 인용하며, 그가 과감한 물갈이와 외부 출신 최고경영자를 요구했다고 적습니다. 그는 금요일 CNBC에서도 이 회사에 대해 말했습니다. 주제. 엔비디아가 중국에 대한 반도체 수출 규정을 지켰는지, 그리고 제한을 피하려고 다른 회사들을 거쳐 판매한 것을 알고 있었는지입니다. 그는 엔비디아 반도체를 중국으로 돌려보낸다고 의심받는 싱가포르 회사 Megaspeed를 무역 제한 명단에 올리지 못한 책임을 다시 상무부에 돌리며, 재무부와 다른 부처들은 몇 달 동안 찬성했지만 “펜을 쥔 쪽”은 상무부라고 말했습니다. 이 기록에 오르는 이유. 이 섹션은 대통령의 말만이 아니라 행정부가 회사에 대해 하는 말을 적는 곳이고, 이미 누가 엔비디아를 이끌어야 한다는 그 자신의 발언과 엔비디아가 무엇을 팔 수 있는지에 대한 그의 결정을 담고 있습니다. 회사가 실적을 발표하기 이틀 전에 내각의 한 사람이 그 회사의 발표 매출을 공개적으로 의심한 일은 그 옆에 놓일 자리가 있습니다. 이것이 아닌 것. 밝혀진 결론도, 기소도, 규정도, 제재도 없습니다. 11월 12일에 사임한 젠슨 황이나 엔비디아에 대해 확정된 것은 아무것도 없고, 엔비디아는 즉각 언급하지 않았습니다. 방송에서 던진 질문은 질문이고 결론이 아니며, 이 페이지는 주장된 것이 아니라 확정된 것을 기록합니다.

entries.text_en: Posted on Truth Social at 4:50 on Saturday afternoon Pacific time — 7:50 in the evening Eastern — with the American market shut until Monday. The post quoted above is the whole of it. What the figures actually were, reported rather than quoted. The election was Tuesday, November 3. The session after it, Thursday November 5, was the worst day for American shares since April 2025: the Nasdaq fell 5.52%, the S&P 500 4.36% and the Dow 3.44%. The reporting that day named this result — Democratic majorities in both chambers of the Congress seated in January — and the worry that it would slow the building of AI data centres, as the cause. His figure of “3 Trillion Dollars” is in the range those reports used for the value wiped off American shares; this page has not independently measured it and does not treat it as established. On “the Market has since gone up”. That is correct as far as it goes, and the answer depends entirely on which day you start from. From the November 6 close to the November 13 close the S&P 500 rose 2.5%, the Nasdaq 2.27% and the Dow 2.07% — the best week since August, and the first winning week after four losing ones. Measured instead from October 30, the last session of October, the S&P 500 is about 0.2% lower, and the Nasdaq index is still about 8.9% below its October record close. Both sums are right. Why it is on the record. His claims about the stock market are claims about two of the five positions on this page, and this one puts a number on a fall and a reason beside it. What is not here. No company, no policy, no tariff, no contract, and no instruction to buy or sell anything.
entries.text_ko: 토요일 오후 서부 시각 4시 50분 — 동부 시각 저녁 7시 50분 — 미국 시장이 월요일까지 닫혀 있는 때에 트루스 소셜에 올렸습니다. 위에 인용한 글이 전부입니다. 실제 숫자는 인용이 아니라 보도로 적습니다. 선거는 11월 3일 화요일이었습니다. 그 다음 거래일인 11월 5일 목요일은 2025년 4월 이후 미국 주식에 가장 나쁜 하루였습니다. 나스닥이 5.52%, S&P 500이 4.36%, 다우가 3.44% 내렸습니다. 그날 보도들은 원인으로 이 선거 결과 — 1월에 들어서는 의회의 상·하원 모두 민주당 다수 — 와 그것이 AI 데이터센터 건설을 늦출 것이라는 걱정을 지목했습니다. 그가 말한 “3조 달러”는 그 보도들이 미국 주식에서 사라진 가치로 쓴 범위 안에 있습니다. 이 페이지는 그것을 따로 재어 보지 않았고, 확정된 사실로 다루지 않습니다. “시장은 그 뒤로 올랐다”에 대해. 그 자체로는 맞는 말이고, 답은 며칠부터 재느냐에 전적으로 달려 있습니다. 11월 6일 종가에서 11월 13일 종가까지 S&P 500은 2.5%, 나스닥은 2.27%, 다우는 2.07% 올랐습니다. 8월 이후 가장 좋은 한 주이고, 네 주 연속 하락 뒤 첫 상승 주입니다. 대신 10월의 마지막 거래일인 10월 30일부터 재면 S&P 500은 약 0.2% 낮고, 나스닥 지수는 아직 10월 최고 종가보다 약 8.9% 아래입니다. 두 계산 모두 맞습니다. 이 기록에 오르는 이유. 주식시장에 대한 그의 주장은 이 페이지의 다섯 포지션 가운데 둘에 대한 주장이고, 이 글은 하락에 숫자를 붙이고 그 옆에 이유를 적었습니다. 여기 없는 것. 회사도, 정책도, 관세도, 계약도 없고, 무엇을 사거나 팔라는 말도 없습니다.

entries.quote: I am working with Senator Tim Scott and, believe it or not, Senator Adam Schiff, and, additionally, Senators John Cornyn, Raphael Warnock, Steve Daines, Bernie Moreno, Tim Sheehy, Alex Padilla, Mark Warner, Thom Tillis, and Chris Coons, together with Representatives Jason Smith, Nathaniel Moran, Brian Jack, Linda Sanchez, and many others, both Republican and Democrat, on the Motion Picture, Television, and Entertainment Revitalization Act. The support and popularity of doing this, and bringing Entertainment back to the United States of America, has been unbelievable! Hollywood, and so many other places, have been virtually "emptied out" by the Tax Incentives, and much more, given by other Countries. Everyone feels strongly about the Motion Picture and Television Industry — and so do I, and we all want to save it. It was MADE IN AMERICA, and must STAY IN AMERICA. The Entertainment Industry has largely moved to Canada, the United Kingdom, Australia, and other countries, but the actors, producers, and all others involved want to come back home! Importantly, hundreds of thousands of Blue Collar Workers will be positively affected, BIG TIME, by the passage of this Bill. The amount of money spent on these Tax Incentives will be made up tenfold by the money pouring into the Treasury's coffers. Meetings are being set up, routinely, with the Leaders of both Parties in order to, GET THIS DONE! It is a very Bipartisan undertaking, especially in that so much of the money being lost to other countries is coming out of the Blue States. Hopefully Republicans and Democrats will get together and finalize this already very actively negotiated Legislation. It can be done quickly, accurately, efficiently and, importantly, will benefit all of America. MAKE OUR ENTERTAINMENT INDUSTRY GREAT AGAIN! President DONALD J. TRUMP

entries.text_en: Posted on Truth Social at 2:52 on Friday afternoon Pacific time — 5:52 in the evening Eastern — nearly two hours after the American market closed. The post quoted above is the whole of it. The subject is a tax credit for making films and television programmes in the United States, and most of the post is a list of the legislators he says he is working with. The names, because naming them is the substance of it. Senators Tim Scott, Adam Schiff, John Cornyn, Raphael Warnock, Steve Daines, Bernie Moreno, Tim Sheehy, Alex Padilla, Mark Warner, Thom Tillis and Chris Coons; Representatives Jason Smith, Nathaniel Moran, Brian Jack and Linda Sanchez. Both parties are on that list, which is the point he makes twice. What the bill would do, reported rather than quoted. Reporting on the Motion Picture, Television, and Entertainment Revitalization Act describes a federal tax credit worth 20% of what a production spends on labour in the United States, rising to a maximum of about 30% with added bonuses, available to projects with budgets above $1 million that do at least 75% of their filming in the country. It was introduced earlier this year with support from members of both parties. The same reporting says it faces a hard road in the few working weeks this Congress has left, and the Congress seated in January is a different one. Earlier on Friday he met the actor Jon Voight at the White House about the same bill, and Voight's representatives have been pressing him to push it now; a member of Congress from Los Angeles put out a statement the same evening calling for it to pass quickly. What is not here. No company. No contract, no subsidy actually paid, no figure for what the credit would cost, and no instruction to buy anything. Nothing has been enacted — a bill under negotiation is not a law, and this page will record what passes rather than what is demanded. Why it is on the record: this section logs what the President says about companies, industries and investments, and here he put his weight behind a federal subsidy aimed at one named industry. Relevance to the five positions is a badge on an entry rather than a gate in front of it, and on this one the honest badge is empty. The Dell endorsement reached none of the five either, and it is one of the most useful entries this record has.
entries.text_ko: 금요일 오후 서부 시각 2시 52분 — 동부 시각 저녁 5시 52분 — 미국 시장이 닫히고 두 시간이 채 안 된 때에 트루스 소셜에 올렸습니다. 위에 인용한 글이 전부입니다. 주제는 미국에서 영화와 텔레비전 프로그램을 만들 때 주는 세금 공제이고, 글의 대부분은 자기가 함께 일한다고 밝힌 의원들의 이름입니다. 그 이름들을 적어 둡니다. 이름을 부르는 것이 이 글의 내용 자체이기 때문입니다. 상원의 팀 스콧, 애덤 시프, 존 코닌, 라파엘 워녹, 스티브 데인스, 버니 모레노, 팀 시히, 알렉스 파디야, 마크 워너, 톰 틸리스, 크리스 쿤스, 그리고 하원의 제이슨 스미스, 너새니얼 모런, 브라이언 잭, 린다 산체스입니다. 그 명단에는 양당이 함께 있고, 그 점을 그는 글에서 두 번 짚습니다. 법안이 무엇을 하는지는 인용이 아니라 보도로 적습니다. 영화·텔레비전·엔터테인먼트 부흥법에 대한 보도들은, 제작사가 미국 안에서 인건비로 쓴 돈의 20%를 연방 세금에서 깎아 주고 추가 조건을 채우면 최대 약 30%까지 올려 주는 제도로 설명합니다. 제작비가 100만 달러를 넘고 촬영의 75% 이상을 미국에서 하는 작품이 대상입니다. 올해 앞서 양당 의원들의 지지를 받아 발의됐습니다. 같은 보도들은 이 의회에 남은 몇 주 안에 통과되기는 쉽지 않다고 적고, 1월에 들어서는 의회는 구성이 다릅니다. 금요일 그보다 앞서 그는 백악관에서 배우 존 보이트를 만나 같은 법안을 이야기했습니다. 보이트 측은 지금 밀어붙여 달라고 요청해 왔습니다. 로스앤젤레스 지역 하원의원 한 명은 같은 날 저녁 빠른 통과를 요구하는 발표를 냈습니다. 여기 없는 것. 회사가 없습니다. 계약도, 실제로 지급된 보조금도, 이 공제에 들어갈 금액도 없고, 무엇을 사라는 말도 없습니다. 법이 된 것도 없습니다. 협상 중인 법안은 법이 아니고, 이 페이지는 요구가 아니라 통과되는 것을 기록합니다. 이 기록에 오르는 이유: 이 섹션은 대통령이 회사와 산업과 투자에 대해 하는 말을 적는 곳이고, 여기서 그는 한 산업을 겨냥한 연방 보조에 자기 무게를 실었습니다. 이 페이지의 다섯 포지션과의 관련성은 항목을 거르는 문이 아니라 항목에 붙는 표식이고, 이 항목에서 정직한 표식은 비어 있습니다. Dell 추천도 다섯 중 어느 것에도 닿지 않았지만, 이 기록에서 가장 쓸모 있는 항목 가운데 하나입니다.
entries.reaction_en: None measurable, and the timing rules it out. He posted nearly two hours after Friday's closing bell, so there is no session left to measure it against and the next one is Monday. As the state of play rather than as a response: the entertainment shares most often named in reporting on this bill finished Friday mixed — Walt Disney up 0.63% at $118.97, Netflix down 0.86% at $62.15, Lionsgate Studios down 0.43% at $14.03. All three had closed before the post existed. No report read for this entry ties any price to it, and none of the five positions on this page is an entertainment company.
entries.reaction_ko: 측정할 수 있는 반응이 없고, 시간이 그것을 막습니다. 금요일 폐장 종이 울리고 두 시간이 채 안 돼 올린 글이라 견주어 잴 거래 시간이 남아 있지 않고, 다음 거래일은 월요일입니다. 반응이 아니라 그때의 상황으로 적자면, 이 법안 보도에 가장 자주 등장하는 엔터테인먼트 주식들은 금요일을 엇갈린 채 마쳤습니다. 월트 디즈니는 0.63% 올라 $118.97, 넷플릭스는 0.86% 내려 $62.15, 라이언스게이트 스튜디오는 0.43% 내려 $14.03입니다. 셋 다 이 글이 올라오기 전에 이미 장을 마쳤습니다. 이 항목을 위해 읽은 어느 보도도 어떤 가격을 이 글에 연결하지 않으며, 이 페이지의 다섯 포지션 가운데 엔터테인먼트 회사는 하나도 없습니다.

entries.text_en: Said in an interview with the sports commentator Stephen A. Smith, recorded in the Roosevelt Room at the White House on Thursday for his online programme and released that evening, after the American market had closed. It was a long sitting that ranged over the midterm result, the war with Iran, petrol and grocery prices and tariffs; the part that belongs on this record is what he said about Nvidia. What he said, quoted. On the telephone call, the sentences at the top of this entry. On whether Huang should have resigned: "Well, the big thing is, was the woman a spy? And I don't know if that's been determined yet. But if the woman was a spy, yes. If the woman was not a spy, perhaps it would be different." On who should take the job: "I think Tim Cook would be a great candidate to run Nvidia." On what becomes of Huang: "Somehow he'll end up on his feet." Reporting on the same interview describes him praising Nvidia's chips as too complex for China to copy and calling Huang a tremendous talent. Earlier the same day, on Hugh Hewitt's radio programme, he said of the affair reporting: "What a horrible thing that is. That's so sad to see that happen." On Thursday evening he reposted Hewitt's praise of that interview. The telephone call, reported rather than quoted. The New York Times reported on Thursday, citing two people briefed on the conversation, that he telephoned Huang on Wednesday, November 11 and urged him to fight to keep his job. Huang resigned the following morning. His own words in the interview put the call on the same day. Nothing in the reporting read for this entry says what else was discussed, and the White House has not described the call. A point of fact this record has already made once. Tim Cook is not Apple's chief executive: he left that job on September 1 and is now executive chairman of Apple's board, with John Ternus as chief executive. What this is not. It is not an appointment, and it is not his to make — Nvidia's chief executive is chosen by Nvidia's board, which has said only that a search has begun and has not named anyone it is considering. Nothing has been heard from Cook. The rest of the interview, set down because this record is about what he says about business. He defended his tariffs, saying "without tariffs, we'd be almost a dead country", said thousands of plants are being built in the United States only to avoid them, and said that if he stopped the tariffs "all of those plants would stop construction immediately". He said petrol prices were the biggest single factor in the midterm result. He named no company in any of that. Why it is on the record: the President telephoned the chief executive of the company that sits inside four of the five positions on this page and asked him not to go, then said so publicly and named the man he would like to see in the job — the second time in one day he named him.
entries.text_ko: 스포츠 해설자 스티븐 A. 스미스와의 대담에서 한 말입니다. 목요일 백악관 루스벨트룸에서 그의 온라인 프로그램을 위해 녹화했고, 미국 시장이 닫힌 뒤 그날 저녁에 공개됐습니다. 중간선거 결과, 이란과의 전쟁, 기름값과 식료품값, 관세까지 두루 다룬 긴 대담이었고, 이 기록에 속하는 대목은 엔비디아에 대해 한 말입니다. 그가 한 말은 인용으로 적습니다. 전화 통화에 대해서는 이 항목 맨 위의 문장들입니다. 황이 사임했어야 했는지에 대해서는 이렇게 말했습니다. "중요한 건 그 여자가 간첩이었느냐다. 그게 아직 밝혀졌는지 나는 모른다. 그런데 그 여자가 간첩이었다면, 그렇다. 간첩이 아니었다면 이야기가 달랐을 수도 있다." 누가 그 자리를 맡아야 하느냐에 대해서는 "팀 쿡이 엔비디아를 이끌 아주 좋은 후보라고 생각한다"고 했습니다. 황이 앞으로 어떻게 되겠느냐에 대해서는 "어떻게든 그는 다시 일어설 것이다"라고 했습니다. 같은 대담을 전한 보도들은 그가 엔비디아의 칩을 중국이 베끼기에는 너무 복잡하다고 치켜세웠고 황을 대단한 재능이라고 불렀다고 적습니다. 같은 날 앞서 휴 휴잇의 라디오 프로그램에서는 그 불륜 보도에 대해 "정말 끔찍한 일이다. 그런 일이 생기는 것을 보니 너무 안타깝다"고 말했습니다. 목요일 저녁에는 그 대담을 칭찬한 휴잇의 글을 자기 계정에 옮겨 올렸습니다. 전화 통화는 인용이 아니라 보도로 적습니다. 뉴욕타임스는 목요일, 그 통화 내용을 전해 들은 두 사람을 인용해, 그가 11월 11일 수요일 황에게 전화를 걸어 자리를 지키기 위해 싸우라고 권했다고 보도했습니다. 황은 다음 날 아침 사임했습니다. 대담에서 그가 직접 한 말도 통화 시점을 같은 날로 가리킵니다. 이 항목을 위해 읽은 보도 가운데 그 통화에서 또 무슨 이야기가 오갔는지 적은 것은 없고, 백악관도 통화 내용을 설명하지 않았습니다. 이 기록이 이미 한 번 짚은 사실이 하나 있습니다. 팀 쿡은 애플의 최고경영자가 아닙니다. 그는 9월 1일에 그 자리에서 물러났고 지금은 애플 이사회의 의장이며, 최고경영자는 존 터너스입니다. 이것이 아닌 것. 임명이 아니고, 그가 정할 수 있는 일도 아닙니다. 엔비디아의 최고경영자는 엔비디아 이사회가 고릅니다. 이사회는 후임자 찾기를 시작했다고만 밝혔고 누구를 보고 있는지는 말하지 않았습니다. 쿡 본인에게서 나온 말도 없습니다. 대담의 나머지도 적어 둡니다. 이 기록은 그가 사업에 대해 하는 말을 모으는 곳이기 때문입니다. 그는 자기 관세를 옹호하며 "관세가 없으면 우리는 거의 죽은 나라가 될 것이다"라고 말했고, 미국 안에 수천 개의 공장이 지어지고 있는데 그것은 오로지 관세를 피하려는 것이라고 했으며, 자기가 관세를 멈추면 "그 공장들은 모두 즉시 공사를 멈출 것이다"라고 했습니다. 중간선거 결과에 가장 크게 작용한 하나는 기름값이었다고도 말했습니다. 그 대목에서 거명한 회사는 없습니다. 이 기록에 오르는 이유: 대통령이, 이 페이지의 다섯 포지션 중 넷 안에 들어 있는 그 회사의 최고경영자에게 전화를 걸어 떠나지 말라고 했고, 그것을 공개적으로 말했으며, 그 자리에 앉았으면 하는 사람의 이름을 불렀습니다 — 하루에 두 번째로 그 이름을 부른 것입니다.
entries.reaction_en: Measured in Friday's session, because the interview came out after Thursday's close — and nothing here is attributed to it. entries.text_en: Posted on Truth Social at 4:18 on Thursday afternoon Pacific time — 7:18 in the evening Eastern — about three hours after the American market closed. The post is one line and a link, and the line is the headline of Eli Lilly's own press release, reposted word for word. He wrote nothing around it. That is why the sentence above sits in quote marks and why this paragraph says whose sentence it is: it is a real, sourced quote of what he posted, and the wording is the company's rather than his. What the company announced, reported rather than quoted. Lilly said on Thursday that it has started building a site at Fogelsville, in Pennsylvania's Lehigh Valley, to make injectable medicines including retatrutide, one of its next-generation weight-loss treatments. It puts the cost at more than $3.5 billion, expects the site to be running by 2031, and says it will employ about 850 people when finished and about 2,000 during construction. It is the tenth new American site the company has announced since 2020 and the fourth of those for injectable medicines. Reporting describes it as the largest investment a life-sciences company has ever made in Pennsylvania. What is not here. No policy of any kind. No tariff, subsidy, contract, deadline or government dollar figure. No instruction to buy anything, and no opinion of his own at all. Reporting on announcements of this sort generally connects the recent wave of American plant-building by drug companies to the threat of tariffs on imported medicines; that connection belongs to the outlets that draw it and not to this post, which makes no claim. Why it is on the record: this section logs what the President says about companies, industries and investments, and here he put a named company's $3.5 billion American factory in front of his followers. Relevance to the five positions on this page is a badge on an entry rather than a gate in front of it — on this one the badge lights the S&P 500, because that is where Lilly sits, and nothing else.

entries.text_en: Posted on Truth Social at 9:24 on Thursday morning Pacific time — 12:24 in the afternoon Eastern — about three hours into the session. The post quoted above is the whole of it. It is a demand for a vote, the subject is the military, and what puts it on this record is the $350 billion. What the money is for, reported rather than quoted. The post itself says only "our brave Warriors" and "this historic investment in our National Security". Reporting on the bill describes the $350 billion as the part of the administration's $1.5 trillion defence request for the 2027 financial year that it hoped to pass by budget reconciliation, and breaks the earlier package down as roughly $113 billion for the defence industrial base — including about $49 billion tied to mining and processing critical minerals in the United States — about $76 billion for munitions, aimed at air and missile-defence interceptors and strike weapons, nearly $54 billion for autonomous systems, $17 billion for the Golden Dome missile-defence fund, and money for F-35 airframes, KC-130J aircraft, landing ships and Virginia-class submarines. One account describes part of the money as paying for the Iran conflict and replacing the munitions used in it. The Defense Secretary has asked for at least $350 billion. The companies named in that reporting are named by the outlets, not by him: Anduril, General Dynamics, Lockheed Martin, Northrop Grumman, Raytheon, SpaceX and Huntington Ingalls. It is not the first time, and that is part of the record. He made the same demand on June 11, in a post that tied the bill to the SAVE America Act and described it as a generational investment in the military, bigger than President Reagan's. Thursday's post is that demand made again, to a Senate that changed hands nine days ago. What has changed since June. Reconciliation needs only a simple majority in the Senate, which is the reason the vehicle was chosen; the Democrats won majorities in both chambers on November 3, and the reporting read for this entry describes the bill as effectively dead under the incoming Congress, with one defence analyst putting its chances at 10% and another noting there is no tax cut to trade for it this time. Nothing has been appropriated, no contract has been awarded and no rule has changed. Why it is on the record: $350 billion of federal money aimed at one kind of manufacturing, demanded in public by the President, is a statement about investment in an industry. entries.text_en: Posted on Truth Social at 7:29 on Thursday morning Pacific time — 10:29 in the morning Eastern — about an hour after the opening bell. The post quoted above is the whole of it. What happened first, reported rather than quoted. Nvidia announced before the open that Huang had resigned as president, chief executive and a director, effective immediately, and that the chief financial officer, Colette Kress, would serve as interim chief executive while the board searches for a permanent successor; the company's filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission also names Harvey C. Jones as the first chair of its board. Huang had run the company he co-founded for 33 years. The resignation follows reporting on two relationships — one with a former executive at Megaspeed, the Singapore cloud company, whom US intelligence is reported to have identified as working for Chinese intelligence, and a second, reported by the New York Times on Wednesday evening, with an Nvidia executive who reported to him — and the independent board investigation opened on November 8, which is already on this record. One point of fact the post invites. Tim Cook is not Apple's chief executive. He stepped down from that job on September 1, 2026 after fifteen years and is now executive chairman of Apple's board; John Ternus is the chief executive. The post says "TIM COOK of Apple", which is accurate as far as it goes. What the post is not. It is not an appointment, and it is not his to make: Nvidia's chief executive is chosen by Nvidia's board, which has said only that a search has begun and has not said whom it is considering. Apple did not immediately respond to a request for comment from Axios, and nothing has been heard from Cook. Two dated things sit ahead of it. Nvidia reports its quarterly results on Tuesday, November 17, after the close, and the chairman of the House Foreign Affairs Committee said on Thursday that Huang has agreed to testify before Congress before Thanksgiving, with the day still being negotiated. Why it is on the record: on the morning the one company inside four of the five positions on this page lost its chief executive, the President publicly named the man he thinks should get the job.
entries.text_ko: 목요일 아침 서부 시각 7시 29분 — 동부 시각 오전 10시 29분 — 개장 종이 울린 지 약 한 시간 뒤에 트루스 소셜에 올렸습니다. 위에 인용한 글이 전부입니다. 먼저 있었던 일은 인용이 아니라 보도로 적습니다. 엔비디아는 개장 전에, 황이 사장과 최고경영자와 이사직에서 즉시 사임했으며, 이사회가 정식 후임자를 찾는 동안 최고재무책임자 콜레트 크레스가 임시 최고경영자를 맡는다고 발표했습니다. 회사가 증권거래위원회에 낸 서류는 하비 C. 존스를 이사회의 첫 의장으로 밝혔습니다. 황은 자신이 공동 창업한 회사를 33년 동안 이끌었습니다. 이 사임은 두 관계에 대한 보도 뒤에 나왔습니다 — 하나는 싱가포르 클라우드 회사 Megaspeed의 전직 임원과의 관계로, 그는 중국 정보기관을 위해 일한 것으로 미국 정보기관이 파악했다고 전해집니다. 또 하나는 수요일 저녁 뉴욕타임스가 보도한, 그에게 보고하던 엔비디아 임원과의 관계입니다 — 그리고 11월 8일에 시작된 이사회의 독립 조사도 그 앞에 있습니다. 그 조사는 이미 이 기록에 올라 있습니다. 이 글이 불러오는 사실 확인이 하나 있습니다. 팀 쿡은 애플의 최고경영자가 아닙니다. 그는 애플을 15년 동안 이끈 뒤 2026년 9월 1일에 그 자리에서 물러났고 지금은 애플 이사회의 의장이며, 최고경영자는 존 터너스입니다. 글은 "애플의 팀 쿡"이라고 적었고, 그 말 자체는 틀리지 않습니다. 이 글이 아닌 것. 임명이 아니고, 그가 정할 수 있는 일도 아닙니다. 엔비디아의 최고경영자는 엔비디아 이사회가 고릅니다. 이사회는 후임자 찾기를 시작했다고만 밝혔고, 누구를 보고 있는지는 말하지 않았습니다. 애플은 악시오스의 논평 요청에 바로 답하지 않았고, 쿡 본인에게서 나온 말도 없습니다. 날짜가 붙은 일이 둘 앞에 있습니다. 엔비디아는 11월 17일 화요일 장 마감 뒤에 분기 실적을 발표합니다. 그리고 하원 외교위원장은 목요일, 황이 추수감사절 전에 의회에서 증언하기로 동의했고 날짜는 협의 중이라고 말했습니다. 이 기록에 오르는 이유: 이 페이지의 다섯 포지션 중 넷 안에 들어 있는 그 한 회사가 최고경영자를 잃은 아침에, 대통령이 그 자리를 누가 맡아야 한다고 생각하는지를 공개적으로 거명했기 때문입니다.
entries.reaction_en: Measured mid-session, with the close still hours away — and nothing here is attributed to the post. Nvidia opened at $151.01, down 13.1% from Wednesday's close of $173.73, and touched $148.80 within the first minutes, down 14.4% and the low of the day so far. By the minute the post went up the shares were about $165, down about 5%, with most of the opening fall already recovered; in the half hour after it they traded between about $163 and $165, and the day's high so far, $167.14, came about 40 minutes later, around 8:10 in the morning Pacific time. Apple was up about 0.7% when the post went up, and its own high for the day had already passed, around 7:01 in the morning Pacific. Measured about 10:15 in the morning Pacific time: Nvidia $165.6, down about 4.7%; Apple $355.6, up about 0.1%. No report read for this entry ties any price to the post. The day's coverage puts Nvidia's fall down to the resignation and its recovery to buyers returning, and attributes the rises in AMD and Broadcom, each about 5% higher, to an analyst upgrade and to the competitive opening Nvidia's leadership upheaval might create. These are intraday figures and the close may differ.

entries.text_en: Posted on Truth Social at 5:07 on Thursday morning Pacific time — 8:07 in the morning Eastern, about an hour and a half before the American market opened. The quoted sentences above are the last three of a longer post; the rest of it asks the Vice President to look into corruption in cities and states run by Democrats, and it names no company. A correction to this record's own work, written down rather than quietly made. Yesterday's midday sweep read this post, saw the corruption subject, and left it out. That reading was right about most of the post and missed the three sentences above. They are in now because of what followed them. What changed. For weeks he had said the war with Iran would end after the midterm elections and that a deal remained possible. On Sunday, November 8, he said renewed attacks were "highly unlikely" if Tehran signed a strong agreement, and American crude settled 4.4% lower the next day. Thursday's post says the opposite, and nothing was announced alongside it: no sanction, no tariff, no order, no date, and no mention of oil or of any energy company. Why it is on the record when no company is named. The Strait of Hormuz carried about a fifth of the world's oil and liquefied gas before the fighting began in February, and Iran moved to choke it off after it did. The cost of fuel sits inside the price of almost everything that is grown, made or carried. A sentence about who holds that waterway is, in its effect, a sentence about the cost of doing business, and the market priced it as one within hours. Relevance to the five positions on this page is a badge on an entry rather than a gate in front of it — on this one the badge lights Costco, which runs a lorry fleet and sells petrol. entries.text_en: Posted on Truth Social at 4:04 on Thursday morning Pacific time — 7:04 in the morning Eastern, more than two hours before the American market opened. The post quoted above is the whole of it. The subject is immigration; the instrument is a tariff, which is why it is on this record. What the post does not say. It does not name a company. It does not name an industry. It does not say which tariff would double, by how much in dollars, or by what date, and it sets no test for when Mexico would count as having stopped the caravans. “Immediately” is the only timing in it. What is already being charged, reported rather than quoted. Reporting on the current position describes a 10% duty on Mexican goods that fall outside the USMCA trade pact, in force since late July 2026, alongside separate duties of about 50% on steel and aluminium and about 25% on cars. Those rates did not change at the November 3 election. Doubling is not defined against any one of them in the post, so this record does not calculate what the threat would cost; it sets down that the threat was made and what the starting point is. One piece of history worth knowing, because it bears on whether a threat like this takes effect. A 25% tariff on all Mexican goods was imposed in February 2025 under emergency powers and ended in February 2026, after the Supreme Court ruled that the law used to impose it does not authorise tariffs. The duties still in force rest on other authorities. Why it is on the record: this section logs what the President says about companies, industries and investments, and a threat to double the tariffs on the country that sends more goods to the United States than almost any other is a statement about the cost of doing business, made in public, with a named consequence. Relevance to the five positions on this page is a badge on an entry rather than a gate in front of it — and on this one the honest badge is empty, because no sector the five sit in is named.
entries.text_ko: 목요일 아침 서부 시각 4시 4분 — 동부 시각 아침 7시 4분, 미국 시장이 열리기 두 시간도 더 전에 트루스 소셜에 올렸습니다. 위에 인용한 글이 전부입니다. 주제는 이민이고, 수단은 관세입니다. 그래서 이 기록에 오릅니다. 이 글이 말하지 않는 것. 회사를 거명하지 않습니다. 산업도 거명하지 않습니다. 어느 관세가 두 배가 되는지, 금액으로는 얼마인지, 언제까지인지 말하지 않고, 멕시코가 카라반을 막은 것으로 인정되는 기준도 정하지 않습니다. 시점에 관한 말은 “즉시” 하나뿐입니다. 이미 매겨져 있는 것은, 인용이 아니라 보도로 적습니다. 현재 상태에 대한 보도들은 USMCA 무역협정 밖에 있는 멕시코산 물품에 2026년 7월 말부터 적용되는 10% 관세, 그리고 그와 별도로 철강·알루미늄에 약 50%, 자동차에 약 25%의 관세를 설명합니다. 이 세율들은 11월 3일 선거로 바뀌지 않았습니다. 글에서 두 배가 그중 어느 것을 기준으로 하는지 정해지지 않았으므로, 이 기록은 그 위협이 얼마를 물릴지 계산하지 않습니다. 위협이 있었다는 사실과 출발점이 어디인지를 적습니다. 알아 둘 만한 지난 일이 하나 있습니다. 이런 위협이 실제로 시행되는지와 관련이 있습니다. 2025년 2월 비상 권한으로 멕시코산 전 품목에 25% 관세가 부과됐고, 그 부과에 쓰인 법이 관세를 허용하지 않는다는 대법원 판단이 나온 뒤 2026년 2월에 끝났습니다. 지금 남아 있는 관세들은 다른 근거에 기대고 있습니다. 이 기록에 오르는 이유: 이 섹션은 대통령이 회사와 산업과 투자에 대해 하는 말을 기록하고, 미국에 가장 많은 물품을 보내는 나라에 관세를 두 배로 올리겠다는 위협은 사업하는 데 드는 값에 관한 공개적인 발언이며 결과까지 명시돼 있습니다. 이 페이지의 다섯 포지션과의 관련성은 항목을 거르는 문이 아니라 항목에 붙는 표식입니다 — 그리고 이 항목에서 정직한 표식은 비어 있습니다. 다섯이 들어 있는 어떤 부문도 거명되지 않았기 때문입니다.

entries.headline: Reported on Wednesday to have approved restrictions three times this year — in May, in August, and again at a White House meeting on November 5 — on companies suspected of passing advanced Nvidia AI chips on to China, and for none of the three to have taken effect, because the Commerce Secretary, Howard Lutnick, held them up each time. These are private decisions described to Axios by administration officials, not a public statement of his. The Commerce Department disputes the account, no rule has been published, and nothing has changed in law
entries.company_en: Nvidia, and chip exports to China — the one policy question that reaches four of the five positions at once. Nvidia is held outright on this page, is the largest single piece of both SPX and QQQ, and is tripled inside SOXL. The firm suspected of the diverting is Megaspeed, based in Singapore. Nvidia itself is not accused of diverting its own chips, and nothing here is a finding against it
entries.company_ko: 엔비디아, 그리고 중국에 대한 반도체 수출 — 이 다섯 포지션 중 넷에 한꺼번에 닿는 하나뿐인 정책 질문입니다. 엔비디아는 이 페이지에서 직접 보유하고 있고, SPX와 QQQ 양쪽에서 가장 큰 한 조각이며, SOXL 안에서는 세 배로 담겨 있습니다. 칩을 돌려보냈다는 의심을 받는 회사는 싱가포르에 있는 Megaspeed입니다. 엔비디아 자신이 자기 칩을 빼돌렸다는 혐의를 받는 것은 아니고, 여기 적은 어느 것도 이 회사에 대한 결론이 아닙니다
entries.text_en: Reported by Axios on Wednesday, November 11, and set down here as reporting rather than inside quote marks, because none of it is a public statement of his. What is reported. He approved restrictions on companies suspected of passing advanced Nvidia artificial-intelligence chips on to China on three separate occasions this year — in May, in August, and again in November. None of the three took effect. The Commerce Secretary, Howard Lutnick, whose department would have to write and enforce such a rule, held them up each time; after the third approval he is described as saying he would develop some options and come back. One official told Axios that Lutnick had earlier met the President privately to change his mind about an export limit. The case at the centre of it. The firm is Megaspeed, based in Singapore and suspected by American officials of routing Nvidia chips into China against American export law; analysts quoted in the reporting estimate it has bought more than $4 billion of Nvidia chips. On November 5 the Treasury Secretary, Scott Bessent, is reported to have challenged Lutnick over the Commerce Department's failure to act on it, first in the Situation Room and then in the Oval Office, where the President asked Elon Musk and Musk backed the restrictions. The account says Lutnick warned that acting would start a trade war with China, and that the President directed officials to proceed anyway. Why it is on this record even though he said none of it in public. This section logs what the President does about companies as well as what he says about them. An export rule aimed at where a named company's chips end up changes that company's business in a way a remark rarely does, and chip-export policy is the single question that reaches Nvidia, SOXL, QQQ and SPX at the same moment. The record would be dishonest if it carried his opinion of who should run Nvidia and left out his decisions about what Nvidia may ship. What this is not, and the denial. No rule has been published, no company has been listed or sanctioned, and no export licence has been withdrawn. The Commerce Department disputed the account. The officials describing it are not named, and neither the White House nor the Commerce Department has confirmed the three approvals. The policy actually on the books is still January's: H200-class chips moved from refusal to case-by-case review, with a 25% tariff on a narrow range of advanced computing chips. A separate thread, so the two are not mixed up. Jensen Huang's resignation on November 12, the closed-door House interview set for December 1 and the Senate hearing invitation for December 3 are a company and a committee acting, not the President, and they sit on the main part of this page. The Commerce Secretary has been summoned separately over chip exports to China.
entries.text_ko: 11월 11일 수요일 Axios가 보도한 내용이고, 인용 부호 안에 넣지 않고 보도로 적습니다. 그 가운데 그가 공개적으로 한 말은 하나도 없기 때문입니다. 보도된 내용. 그는 올해 세 번에 걸쳐, 엔비디아의 고성능 인공지능 반도체를 중국으로 넘긴다고 의심받는 회사들에 대한 제한 조치를 승인했습니다. 5월, 8월, 그리고 11월입니다. 세 번 모두 시행되지 않았습니다. 그런 규정을 만들고 집행해야 하는 부처를 맡은 상무장관 하워드 러트닉이 그때마다 붙잡아 두었고, 세 번째 승인 뒤에는 "방안을 만들어 다시 오겠다"는 식으로 답했다고 적혀 있습니다. 한 당국자는 Axios에, 러트닉이 그 전에 대통령을 따로 만나 수출 제한에 대한 생각을 바꾸게 했다고 전했습니다. 중심에 있는 사안. 그 회사는 싱가포르에 있는 Megaspeed로, 미국 당국자들은 이 회사가 미국 수출법을 어기고 엔비디아 칩을 중국으로 돌려보냈다고 의심합니다. 보도에 인용된 분석가들은 이 회사가 엔비디아 칩을 40억 달러 넘게 사들인 것으로 추정합니다. 11월 5일 재무장관 스콧 베선트가 상무부가 이 문제에 손을 쓰지 않는다며 러트닉을 추궁했다고 전해집니다. 처음에는 상황실에서, 그다음에는 집무실에서였고, 집무실에서 대통령이 일론 머스크에게 의견을 물었고 머스크는 제한에 찬성했습니다. 이 보도는 러트닉이 그렇게 하면 중국과 무역 전쟁이 시작될 것이라고 경고했고, 대통령은 그래도 진행하라고 지시했다고 적습니다. 그가 공개적으로 한 말이 하나도 없는데도 이 기록에 오르는 이유. 이 섹션은 대통령이 회사에 대해 하는 말뿐 아니라 회사에 대해 하는 일도 적습니다. 어떤 회사의 칩이 어디까지 갈 수 있는지를 정하는 수출 규정은, 말 한마디가 좀처럼 하지 못하는 방식으로 그 회사의 사업을 바꿉니다. 그리고 반도체 수출 정책은 엔비디아, SOXL, QQQ, SPX에 한꺼번에 닿는 하나뿐인 질문입니다. 누가 엔비디아를 이끌어야 한다는 그의 의견은 싣고, 엔비디아가 무엇을 팔 수 있는지에 대한 그의 결정은 빼놓는다면 이 기록은 정직하지 않을 것입니다. 이것이 아닌 것, 그리고 부인. 공개된 규정도, 명단에 오르거나 제재를 받은 회사도, 취소된 수출 허가도 없습니다. 상무부는 이 보도 내용을 부인했습니다. 내용을 전한 당국자들의 이름은 나오지 않고, 백악관도 상무부도 그 세 번의 승인을 확인하지 않았습니다. 실제로 시행되고 있는 정책은 여전히 1월의 것입니다. H200급 칩은 거부에서 사안별 심사로 옮겨졌고, 좁은 범위의 고성능 연산용 칩에는 25% 관세가 붙어 있습니다. 섞이지 않게 따로 적어 두는 갈래. 11월 12일 젠슨 황의 사임, 12월 1일로 잡힌 하원 비공개 면담, 12월 3일 상원 청문회 출석 요청은 회사와 의회가 한 일이지 대통령이 한 일이 아니고, 이 페이지의 본문에 있습니다. 상무장관은 중국에 대한 반도체 수출 문제로 따로 소환됐습니다.
entries.reaction_en: Not separable, and nothing here is offered as a response to it. The story appeared on Wednesday, November 11, a day the chip trade was being driven by something else: Nvidia rose 2.87% to $173.73 in the regular session on CoreWeave's results, and then fell more than 7% in after-hours trading when the Wall Street Journal reported that the board was preparing to remove Jensen Huang. The main chip index rose 6.01% that day. Across the four sessions since, Nvidia has fallen to $162.85, about 6% below its November 11 close, on the resignation itself and on HSBC's downgrade of the shares on Friday — neither of which is this. entries.reaction_ko: 떼어내서 잴 수 없고, 여기 적은 어느 것도 이 보도에 대한 반응으로 적는 것이 아닙니다. 이 기사는 11월 11일 수요일에 나왔는데, 그날 반도체 거래를 움직인 것은 다른 일이었습니다. 엔비디아는 정규장에서 CoreWeave 실적에 2.87% 올라 $173.73이 됐고, 그 뒤 월스트리트저널이 이사회가 젠슨 황을 물러나게 할 준비를 하고 있다고 보도하자 시간외 거래에서 7%가 넘게 내렸습니다. 주요 반도체 지수는 그날 6.01% 올랐습니다. 그 뒤 네 거래일 동안 엔비디아는 $162.85까지 내려 11월 11일 종가보다 약 6% 아래가 됐습니다. 사임 자체와, 금요일 HSBC의 투자의견 하향 때문이고, 둘 다 이 보도와는 다른 일입니다. 이 항목을 위해 읽은 어느 보도도 어떤 가격을 이 Axios 기사에 연결하지 않습니다.
